combos.name: Hemoplague All-In
combos.situation: When a priority target is within reach and you have enough damage to secure the kill.
combos.execution: Apply Hemoplague first to amplify incoming damage. Charge E while approaching, cast Q, and use W if necessary to avoid retaliation.
combos.mistake: Don't automatically use W. It may be your only way to survive the enemy's response.

combos.name: Flash Teamfight Engage
combos.situation: When multiple enemies are grouped and you can reach their carries.
combos.execution: Begin charging E before entering, Flash into position, and cast Hemoplague on multiple enemies. Release E, target a priority enemy with Q, and save W for incoming threats.
combos.mistake: Engaging without checking enemy crowd control can result in an immediate death.

sections.heading: Laning Phase: Survive and Scale
paragraphs: Vladimir's early game is primarily about collecting gold without losing too much health.
His early damage is limited, and his cooldowns are relatively long. Against aggressive opponents, focus on last-hitting and maintaining enough health to remain in lane.
Use Transfusion to secure minions, heal, and prepare empowered trades.
You don't need to win every exchange. Vladimir can recover health over time while many opponents consume mana or other resources.
Against ranged mages, allow the wave to approach your tower and avoid unnecessary poke.
Against melee champions, punish predictable last-hitting attempts with Q and basic attacks.
Once you have several points in Q and your first AP components, your ability to control the lane improves.
bullets: Prioritize consistent farming over risky early kills.
Save W when the enemy jungler could gank.
Avoid spending excessive health on E waveclear.
Use empowered Q to threaten opponents and control space.

sections.heading: Mid Game: Reach Your Power Spikes
paragraphs: Vladimir becomes significantly stronger after acquiring AP, ability haste, and additional ranks in his main abilities.
Push waves when safe and look for opportunities around Dragons, Rift Herald, and Baron Nashor.
Fights in narrow areas are especially valuable because your AoE abilities can hit several enemies.
Avoid chasing highly mobile champions when Flash and Ghost are unavailable.
bullets: Farm side lanes without overextending.
Group around important objectives.
Look for flanking angles toward enemy carries.
Track your summoner spell cooldowns before committing.

sections.heading: Teamfights: Timing Is Everything
paragraphs: Vladimir can decide a teamfight with a well-placed Hemoplague.
However, he isn't a traditional tank and shouldn't always engage first. His limited mobility and vulnerability when Sanguine Pool is unavailable can be heavily punished.
Wait for enemies to use some of their crowd control, find a flank, and engage when priority targets become accessible.
Apply Hemoplague before your main damage rotation and use Sanguine Pool to survive while waiting for the detonation.
bullets: Prioritize enemy carries when you can reach them safely.
Try to hit multiple champions with Hemoplague.
Don't waste W for a small amount of extra damage.
Use Hemoplague's healing to continue fighting.

difficult.advice: His ultimate can lock Vladimir down and allow his team to secure a kill. Avoid engaging while Malzahar's ultimate is available, and consider defensive itemization.

difficult.name: Orianna
difficult.advice: Orianna can control waves and punish Vladimir from a greater distance. Prioritize farming and avoid unnecessary poke while waiting for empowered Q opportunities.

difficult.name: Anivia
difficult.advice: Her zone control makes approaching targets difficult. Avoid fighting inside her ultimate and respect her waveclear and crowd control.

difficult.name: Kog'Maw
difficult.advice: Kog'Maw can punish Vladimir from range with high sustained damage. Look for flanks rather than approaching directly through open areas.

favorable.name: Katarina
favorable.advice: Vladimir's sustain makes short trades less effective, while Sanguine Pool can avoid important parts of Katarina's burst. Punish predictable dagger pickups and avoid giving her opportunities to snowball through skirmishes.

favorable.name: Yone
favorable.advice: Sanguine Pool can avoid important parts of Yone's combo. Punish predictable engages and maintain safe spacing when his ultimate is available.

favorable.name: Fizz
favorable.advice: Vladimir's healing helps him survive repeated short trades. Save Sanguine Pool to avoid Fizz's ultimate or another crucial part of his burst combo.

practicePlan.title: 1. Empowered Q Drill
steps: In Practice Tool, repeatedly cast Transfusion on minions and training dummies.
Observe when empowered Q becomes available and how long it remains active.
Practice approaching targets before the empowered window expires.
Goal: Recognize your strongest trading windows automatically.

practicePlan.title: 2. E + W Combo Drill
steps: Start charging Tides of Blood and activate Sanguine Pool before releasing E.
Repeat the combination from different distances and practice controlling your positioning.
Goal: Execute the defensive combo consistently without wasting movement or damage.

practicePlan.title: 3. Teamfight Review
steps: Watch a replay and review each major teamfight.
Identify when you used W, how many enemies you hit with R, and whether a better entry angle existed.
Goal: Improve your engagement timing and survivability.

faq.q: Is Vladimir difficult to learn?
faq.a: His abilities are relatively straightforward, but mastering cooldown management, positioning, and teamfight timing takes practice.

faq.q: What is the best Vladimir build in Patch 26.22?
faq.a: A common build starts with Stormsurge and follows with items such as Liandry's Torment, Void Staff, and Rabadon's Deathcap. The ideal combination depends on the matchup and enemy team.

faq.q: What skill order should I use?
faq.a: Max Q first, E second, and W last, leveling R whenever available.

faq.q: When should I use Sanguine Pool?
faq.a: Primarily to avoid dangerous abilities, crowd control, and potentially lethal damage.

faq.q: Is Vladimir good for beginners?
faq.a: Vladimir has accessible basic mechanics, but learning to farm consistently, manage health, and time teamfight engagements is essential.

faq.q: Is Vladimir better mid or top?
faq.a: Mid is his primary role in this guide. Top is also viable but involves different matchups and positioning requirements.
